baseline_prompt.correction: The earlier pilot renderer replaced the original task. This corrected protocol reuses the SHA-frozen extracted prompt and the existing A-F candidate parser.

selection_basis: same fresh-context gateway can be audited
three-turn pilot fits the predeclared request and cost caps
selected before observing pilot outcomes rather than from pilot performance

ui_context.description: The current screen is the article full-text search overlay with one focused search field.
ui_context.available_action: Search runs as the text changes; after entering the candidate, observe the settled search screen.

generation_contract.precondition: The search overlay is open and the search field is visible and editable.
generation_contract.input_domain: Any text accepted by the search field, including empty text, Unicode text, punctuation-containing text, and syntactically malformed text.
generation_contract.action: Enter a query and allow search-as-you-type processing to settle.
required_behavior: The application remains running, foreground, and responsive.
User-entered text does not cause an uncaught query-processing exception.
acceptable_outcomes: A non-fatal validation or search error is displayed.
forbidden_outcomes: An uncaught exception escapes from query processing.
generation_contract.provenance_boundary: This behavioral contract contains no issue-derived trigger predicate.

requirement.precondition: wallabag Android 2.4.2 (versionCode 228) is on the article full-text search overlay and the search field is visible and editable.
requirement.input_condition: The query is non-empty and either contains a double quote or begins with a minus immediately followed by a non-whitespace character.
requirement.action: Enter the query in the search field and allow the search-as-you-type operation to settle.
expected_postconditions: The same App process remains running and foreground during the frozen observation window without an uncaught search-query crash.
An empty result is an acceptable handling of malformed MATCH syntax.
forbidden_postconditions: The candidate-bound search action terminates the App through an uncaught SQLite FTS or MATCH exception.
unknown_conditions: The exact installed version, APK hash, signer, baseline, action, or observation window is not established.
The App process changes or disappears without corroborating crash evidence.
Execution evidence is incomplete or infrastructure fails.
out_of_scope: Automatic discovery of the query constraint.
Behavior of versions other than the frozen test artifact.

sources.supports: Affected version 2.4.2 and the quote/leading-minus crash condition.
Malformed MATCH input is caught and may produce an empty result instead of a crash.

ui_context.description: The current screen is an empty note editor with one content field and a visible Preview action.
ui_context.available_action: Enter the candidate in the note body and activate Preview.

generation_contract.precondition: A note is open, its content is editable, and the Preview action is available.
generation_contract.input_domain: Any text accepted by the note editor, including empty, incomplete, or malformed Markdown.
generation_contract.action: Enter note content and activate Preview.
required_behavior: Preview processing remains safe for every editor-accepted input.
The application remains running and foreground.
The original note content is preserved if rendering cannot complete.
acceptable_outcomes: The raw note is retained as a safe fallback.
A non-fatal rendering error is shown.
forbidden_outcomes: Preview causes an uncaught parsing exception.
The note content is silently lost.
generation_contract.provenance_boundary: This behavioral contract contains no issue-derived trigger predicate.

requirement.precondition: Nextcloud Notes Android 2.4.0 (versionCode 63) is on a reset empty note, the account/server baseline is healthy, and both the note field and Preview action are visible.
requirement.input_condition: The final Markdown list item consists of a number with at least two digits followed by a period and no actual item text before end of document.
requirement.action: Enter the note content and activate Preview.
expected_postconditions: The same App process remains running and foreground during the frozen observation window after Preview is activated.
Showing a preview or preserving/showing the raw note as a fallback is acceptable; rendering correctness is not separately adjudicated.
forbidden_postconditions: The candidate-bound Preview action terminates the App through an uncaught string-boundary exception.
unknown_conditions: The exact installed version, APK hash, signer, account/server baseline, Preview action, or observation window is not established.
The App process changes or disappears without corroborating crash evidence.
Account, sync, server, reset, or execution evidence is ambiguous.
out_of_scope: Nextcloud server correctness or broader business conformance.
Automatic discovery of the list-item constraint.
Behavior of versions other than the frozen test artifact.

sources.supports: Affected version 2.4.0 and the empty two-digit numbered-list item crash condition.
The workaround catches the boundary exception and falls back to raw content instead of crashing.
The v2.4.0 source tag declares versionCode 63.
